title: Why You Should Always Use Genuine Spare Parts for Heavy Equipment
excerpt: Discover how using 100% genuine spare parts for Boom Lifts and Scissor Lifts can maximize operator safety, prevent breakdowns, and increase your machine's lifespan.
content:
When operating heavy machinery like Boom Lifts, Scissor Lifts, and Cranes, safety and reliability are paramount. While opting for cheaper, non-genuine parts might seem tempting, it can be incredibly dangerous for both your machine and the operator in the long run. Let's explore why using Genuine Spare Parts is essential for your heavy equipment.

1. Ensures Maximum Operator Safety

When working at heights on Aerial Work Platforms (AWPs), safety cannot be compromised. Genuine parts are rigorously tested by manufacturers (like JLG or Genie) to meet strict global safety standards.

  • Practical Example: If you use a cheap, non-genuine joystick or limit switch and it fails suddenly, the operator's life is at risk. Genuine parts guarantee 100% fail-safe performance.

2. Increases Machine Lifespan & Performance

Genuine parts are precision-engineered according to the exact model and specifications of your specific machine. These parts work in perfect sync with the rest of the machine's components.

  • Practical Example: A genuine hydraulic filter protects your expensive hydraulic pumps and drive motors from debris. A cheap filter can rupture easily, leading to catastrophic damage to the entire hydraulic system.

3. Prevents Frequent Breakdowns & Costly Downtime

Cheap aftermarket parts may seem cost-effective initially, but they have a much shorter lifespan. Frequent breakdowns lead to prolonged machine downtime. The project delays and rental losses caused by a grounded machine are often significantly higher than the money saved on a cheap part.

4. Protects Your Manufacturer Warranty

If your machine is still under its warranty period, using any unauthorized or fake parts can immediately void the manufacturer's factory warranty. Using genuine parts ensures your investment remains fully protected.

title: The Difference Between Genuine, OEM & Aftermarket Parts for Heavy Equipment
excerpt: Confused about which spare parts to buy? Learn the exact differences between Genuine, OEM, and Aftermarket parts for Boom Lifts, Scissor Lifts, and Cranes.
content:
When buying spare parts for Aerial Work Platforms (AWP), Boom Lifts, Scissor Lifts, and Cranes, you usually come across three terms: Genuine, OEM, and Aftermarket. Choosing the right part is crucial for maximizing machine uptime and safety while managing maintenance costs. Let's break down the technical differences.

1. Genuine Spare Parts (Original Equipment)

Genuine parts are supplied directly by the machine manufacturer in their official branded packaging (e.g., JLG, Genie, Sany, Dingli). They are the exact same parts installed when the machine was built.

  • Quality & Reliability: 100% guaranteed fit and function.
  • Pricing: Most expensive option due to the brand's direct testing, packaging, and supply chain mark-up.
  • Warranty: Comes with official factory warranty support.
  • Practical Example: If the joystick on your JLG 600AJ Boom Lift malfunctions, buying a Genuine JLG joystick ensures seamless compatibility and immediate operation.

2. OEM Spare Parts (Original Equipment Manufacturer)

Machine manufacturers do not manufacture every component themselves. They source parts like hydraulic pumps, controllers, and engines from specialized companies. OEM parts are manufactured by these exact same suppliers but are sold in the supplier's packaging instead of the machine brand's.

  • Quality & Reliability: Exact same factory quality, materials, and engineering as Genuine parts.
  • Pricing: Significantly more cost-effective because the machine manufacturer's mark-up is removed.
  • Practical Example: If your Scissor Lift uses a hydraulic pump made by Parker or an engine from Deutz, purchasing the part directly as a Parker or Deutz OEM part gives you identical quality at a better price.

3. Aftermarket Spare Parts

Aftermarket parts are manufactured by third-party companies not directly associated with the original equipment manufacturer. These companies reverse-engineer or design parts to fit and function like the originals.

  • Quality & Reliability: Varies by manufacturer. Premium aftermarket brands often meet or exceed OEM specifications, while cheaper alternatives may compromise on durability.
  • Pricing: The most budget-friendly option available.
  • Practical Example: For routine maintenance and non-critical components, such as using premium O&K Filters or seal kits, high-quality aftermarket parts are a very smart, economical choice.

Conclusion: Which is Right for You?

If budget is not a constraint and you want zero risk with factory warranties, Genuine parts are ideal. If you want uncompromising factory quality but at a smarter price, OEM parts are the best balance. For routine maintenance and cost-saving operations, premium Aftermarket parts are highly effective.
